000111222333102132030 - ASI: 20

Rules:
  00 = 0 * 0
  10 = 1 * 0
  11 = 1 * 1
  20 = 2 * 0
  21 = 2 * 1
  22 = 2 * 2
  23 = 2 * 3
  30 = 3 * 0
  33 = 3 * 3
  011 = 0 * 11
  320 = 3 * 20
  1021 = 10 * 21
  2223 = 22 * 23
  00011 = 00 * 011
  32030 = 320 * 30
  000111 = 00011 * 1
  331021 = 33 * 1021
  0001112223 = 000111 * 2223
  33102132030 = 331021 * 32030
